description: This chart illustrates an entity topic distribution across five distinct categories, presented in a donut chart format with a 3D shadow effect along its inner and outer edges. A legend titled "Topics" is positioned within the central empty space of the chart, and exact percentage labels are displayed directly inside each respective slice near the outer boundary. The largest slice, labeled "Moive," is colored light blue and represents 41.2% of the total. The "Person" category is depicted in light pink and accounts for 30.5% of the chart. The "Common" slice is light green and makes up 14.9% of the distribution. Additionally, the "Book" slice is colored light yellow and comprises 9.1%, while the smallest category, "Sport," is shown in light purple at 4.3%. Visually, the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strictly ascending or descending order based on their proportional size.
